distribution.summary: 福建；广西；贵州；湖南；江西；四川；台湾；云南；浙江；香港
distribution.narrative: Cognato et al. (2024) provides modern specimen and molecular evidence from Fujian, Guangxi, Guizhou, Jiangxi and Zhejiang, and Nantou, Taiwan. Older baseline records from Hunan, Sichuan and Yunnan are retained. Guangdong and Hainan are moved to historical/questionable for S. niisimai because verified southern material is S. pilosus. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepted Taiwan occurrence under the same species concept; it is retained as earlier supporting evidence and does not override the 2024 revision. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, adds secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: The 2024 revision reports Cornus controversa, Machilus and Ligustrum. These are added without replacing baseline host records; older host records may include material requiring reassessment after separation of S. pilosus. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species only broadly as a polyphagous ambrosia beetle, so no additional host taxon is promoted from that source.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Sueus niisimai (Eggers, 1926).

nomenclature_note: Sueus niisimai (Eggers, 1926) remains valid and is supported as a distinct lineage. Cognato et al. (2024) restores S. pilosus from its former synonymy, narrowing the interpretation of southern S. niisimai records.
